story.text: 그날 저녁, 규현에게서 메시지가 왔다. 평소와 달리 어딘가 조심스러운 말투였다.
story.reading: geu-nal jeo-nyeok, gyu-hyeon-e-ge-seo me-si-ji-ga wat-da. pyeong-so-wa dal-li eo-din-ga jo-sim-seu-reo-un mal-tu-yeot-da.
story.en: That evening, a message came from Kyuhyun. Unlike usual, his tone felt somehow careful.

story.text: 이번 주말에 시간 있냐는 짧은 질문 하나. 나는 괜히 심장이 두근거려서 답장을 몇 번이나 고쳐 썼다.
story.reading: i-beon ju-mal-e si-gan iss-nya-neun jjalb-eun jil-mun ha-na. na-neun gwaen-hi sim-jang-i du-geun-geo-ryeo-seo dap-jang-eul myeot beon-i-na go-chyeo sseot-da.
story.en: A short question — did I have time this weekend. My heart, for no clear reason, started pounding, and I rewrote my reply several times.

story.text: 다음 날 만난 그는, 여느 때처럼 웃고 있었지만 평소보다 말이 조금 느렸다. '요즘 계속 바쁘다고 하셨죠? 저도 알아요, 여행 일정 빡빡한 거.'
story.reading: da-eum nal man-nan geu-neun, yeo-neu ttae-cheo-reom ut-go iss-eot-ji-man pyeong-so-bo-da mal-i jo-geum neu-ryeot-da. yo-jeum gye-sok ba-ppeu-da-go ha-syeot-jyo? jeo-do al-a-yo, yeo-haeng il-jeong ppak-ppak-han geo.
story.en: When I met him the next day, he was smiling as usual, but he was talking a little slower than normal. "You said you've been busy lately, right? I know — I get it, your trip schedule's packed."

story.text: 잠깐의 정적. 그리고 그는 평소의 장난기를 걷어내고, 낮고 차분한 목소리로 말했다. '이번 주말엔 바쁜 척하지 말고, 나랑 데이트하지, 아가씨?'
story.reading: jam-kkan-ui jeong-jeok. geu-ri-go geu-neun pyeong-so-ui jang-nan-gi-reul geot-eo-nae-go, nat-go cha-bun-han mok-so-ri-ro mal-haet-da. i-beon ju-mal-en ba-ppeun cheok-ha-ji mal-go, na-rang de-i-teu-ha-ji, a-ga-ssi?
story.en: A brief silence. And then, shedding his usual playfulness, he spoke in a low, steady voice. "This weekend, don't pretend to be busy — let's go on a date, agassi."

story.text: 늘 여유롭던 그의 목소리가 순간 낮고 진지해졌다. 나는 숨을 멈춘 채 그의 눈을 바라봤다.
story.reading: neul yeo-yu-rop-deon geu-ui mok-so-ri-ga sun-gan nat-go jin-ji-hae-jyeot-da. na-neun sum-eul meom-chun chae geu-ui nun-eul ba-ra-bwat-da.
story.en: His voice, always so easygoing, suddenly dropped low and turned serious. I held my breath and looked into his eyes.

story.text: 정적이 길어지자 그는 먼저 시선을 피하며 다시 웃었다. '…농담처럼 말했지만, 이거 사실 저한테는 꽤 용기 낸 거예요.'
story.reading: jeong-jeog-i gil-eo-ji-ja geu-neun meon-jeo si-seon-eul pi-ha-myeo da-si ut-eot-da. …nong-dam-cheo-reom mal-haet-ji-man, i-geo sa-sil jeo-han-te-neun kkwae yong-gi naen geo-ye-yo.
story.en: When the silence stretched too long, he broke eye contact first and smiled again. "...I said it like a joke, but honestly, that took quite a bit of courage for me."

story.text: 늘 능글맞기만 하던 그가 보인 그 잠깐의 진심에, 나는 대답 대신 조용히 고개를 끄덕였다.
story.reading: neul neung-geul-maj-gi-man ha-deon geu-ga bo-in geu jam-kkan-ui jin-sim-e, na-neun dae-dap dae-sin jo-yong-hi go-gae-reul kkeu-deok-yeot-da.
story.en: At that brief flash of sincerity from someone who was usually all smooth talk, I answered not with words, but with a quiet nod.

words.example_en: Do you have time this weekend?
I've been so busy lately that we couldn't meet.
Want to go on a date this weekend?

words.example: 그 말을 하는 데 용기가 필요했다.
words.example_reading: geu mal-eul ha-neun de yong-gi-ga pil-yo-haet-da
words.example_en: It took courage to say that.
